## adHF: The ADHD Revolution

The adHF is a reckless collective of punks, artists, writers, and hip-hop heads engineering underground movements that purposely never break the surface. You know, the whole sunlight thing. We get bored way too fast, and honestly, we're just one small splinter of the greater, chaotic Happy Fun Pactus.

Our roster of mixers, designers, and producers is a sprawling mess that includes AychEff Zero, HF-1, HF Trinity, AychEff Prime... and a massive crew of others. I have absolutely no idea how the whole "numbers" naming convention even started. You've got HF Syphon, DJ Ayanami, hell, even AychEff Mom. Look, we're all over the damn map.

Can you even picture an actual ADHD revolution? It wouldn't be some highly organized strike. It'd just be a massive mob of punk kids screaming "Charge!" and then immediately sprinting off in a thousand different directions.

_Welcome to the world of audio graffiti._

This is, hands down, the street-level shit that peeps book me to DJ the most for. That "Dust of Gods" set loaded up in the media player over there? That's just one tiny, fragmented piece of the adHF.

_You don't even know the half of it._

That painting up above? Totally ChatGPT... and that's a lie. The real painting was on a different wall, the machine just moved its location. AychEff Zero painted it on the wall of an apartment, and if you weren't there, then you missed it. And that's also a trend with the Fun Pak. You need to be there. All the art, the music, the gatherings... they're all out the window come morning.

Were you there as mixed quotes from _The Matrix_ into _Cut 'n Fisted_ on the deck of Mojo's? Gaea was there, so was Mephie. Were you there when I first freestyle rapped "Transient Charm" over a payphone from an IHOP in the middle of night? Hell no you weren't! Only my brother Tristan heard that shit. Were you there when AychEff Zero painted "Successica" on the wall of the apartment? Prolly not, chum, not fucking likely at all. But Ren was there.

And we just happened to get a photo of the real thang:

content.text:
'I have none of the dignity that my creations retain.'

\~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ Implied the preacher. ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

and yet its stock is ever so full of that which I lack.

So, can an impure person create a pure gem,

or is his life to govern what he creates? ~~~~~~~~~~~~

I don't believe it matters, one way or the other...

\~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ (@ least I hope not!) ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

What really matters-is the release.  The flood gates drawn

back.  The removal of yourself from the creative process.

For in that removal, the presence of art is all that remains.

The creative process is just that -- a non involved wave of

an alien force which needs only the body to function.~

'It' draws upon your memories-not you.

'It' paints or writes or spins.  It expects to get

your way.

\- For instance -

\- What is a Kung Fu honour pimp? -

\- Why do physicians sterilize death row needles? -

what is the HappyFunPak?

what is AychEff?
content.html:
Nothing Quick to grasp or quick to feel.
Not some stylized self improvement scheme.
Certainly no guru.              Certainly not.
     But a part of yourself.
Just an undiscovered portion -  simply you -

But... not....

Think of it this way-

if a bunch of punk kids found the
reason why you love yourself- if they
wrote themselves down on paper
                   if they threw
it away.....would you believe them ten
years later.  Could you swallow thier
story?  with no proof?

  Certainly not.

You would have to know.  Punk kids, after all,
are shifty (at best).

And these kids... they did drugs.
  lots - of - them

Punk kids on drugs who claim to.....whatever

luckily, however, they remembered the name
of the comic strip. . .

 - on the HappyFunPak -

which is nothing more than 13 year old bastards
who have better things to do than pay attention to
their teachers.  They have a pen and a spiral notebook -
they want money for tang and OK Sodas ... ....
They realize that middle schoolers love sex.....
that they love violence - dark humor -death-
things denied to them by the institutions they
must attend.
So the 13 year old bastards give a face
to what is secretly wanted by everyone ... even
teachers (to noones great surprise).
When the comics are created and taken
by authority - yet it's makers are no reprimanded
in any way- the production merely triple$
to make up for the 'soft copies.'  And everbody
goes home happy.

But not me.  No - not this one.

(written by AychEff Zero)

content.text: ## HF-1 Down: The Fall of the Captain Today's 2026, July 28... and my brother Zero just sent me a line saying that we've lost HF-1 to his own hands. Our wrecking ball exited himself stage left. Toto Kaos and friends threw him a going away party yesterday ([Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/events/1353297189651217)). So if you're OG HF and you knew the pop 'n lock troll himself, pour yourself a tall one and raise it to the sky. _Here's to you motherfucker!_ June 19th, taking yourself out late on a Thursday night going into Friday. Most peeps are ready to kick off the weekend and you waited two days after your birthday. So I hope someone is saving your art, your sketches, and books... that, and I hope you made your life goal of outliving your piece-of-shit father like you set out to do! You always said that living was the most punk ass shit you could fucking do in this world... and even when we disagreed, you spoke your mind and laid it out like you saw it. That's more than half the human creatures on this planet can lay claim to. I can't even believe AychEff Zero just sent me that message.. . you better be laughing that you've got me writing this now when I literally JUST wrote about the founders days ago for this entry. I ain't got no Jameson to cheers you with, so some JB 'n Gin's gonna have to cut it. _See you on the other side you old bastard!_ _"I'm the Captian of this sinking ship... ALL ABOARD!!!"_ ~**HF-1**; aka, "**JT Kooistra**"; aka, "**Zelos Smite**"; aka, "**El Blanco Muerte**"

## Lost + Found Footage

_Cut 'n Fisted, Mob God?_ Those mixes from the adHF might be lost to time. BUT! Skybreak saved copies of the ones sent out to the email list subscribers. Some of those you might just be seeing again. In fact, they could be shimmying right up to this page right here. They're highly illegal and explicit and not a single license was secured. Oh wait... that's all of this shit! _Who am I kidding?_

Maybe "the black book" and "old gray" and "red twisty" might still survive. It depends on what the thieves left when they broke into my van. Fitting, right? If they left 'em then we've still got 'em. The adHF gave birth to so many other mixes, like "Lucid" ([SoundCloud](https://soundcloud.com/adhdrevolution/adhf13l-lucid)) becoming the starter for the smash DJ set _"[Dreamstep (A lullaby for the grave)](other-dj-mixes)"_ . . or even _"[The Passions of Blood, Smoke, and Oil](the-passions)"_ which itself follows the unspoken principles of The ADHD Revolution. It should go without saying that every single one of my live shows, like "[Warriors in Waiting](warriors-in-waiting-live-set)", is just as political, spiritual, and filled with our street-level bullshit as all our other graffiti tags.

Many of our writings came out of the HF, with "[Landlore](landlore)" and "[Everything Will Be OK](everything-will-be-ok)" being just two of my own worth mentioning. Peeps have seen me pasting up the HF as graffiti and wildstyle in multiple places, with others in The HF itself doing the same. It's weird when you start having copycats.. . 'n ya know what? _They're as HF AF!_ You paste it up, _you're in!_

It's hilarious that relics of the revolution still stand... in their broken forgotten forms. In fact, [the original adHF Blogger](https://adhdrevolution.blogspot.com/) is somehow still up and apparently even [the old MySpace page](https://myspace.com/theadhf). Somehow even the [Facebook page for Happy Fun Pak](https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=100070066552222) still stands.

You really can't trust any of these words... . or the art. There's no set genre, and the only themes pass in the moment before fervently smashing the CHANGE CHANNEL button. But below it all is a feeling. If it vibes with you, _then you're in!_
"The ADHD Revolution is all about non-seriousness... seriously."

content.text: ## adHF: Haus Pâté Oh yeah, this mix survived. Despite having no set genre and basically freestyle DJing every mix, after years of dropping these on peeps it became clear that breakbeat and big beat stood out as "most mixed" in _The ADHD Revolution_. Somehow it's managed to survive up on Mixcloud. Bless their oily hearts and may they never change. I hope they're somehow making scrilla off this shit 'cuz they're the last outpost for alotta these mixes. Linkage! * [Stream Haus Pâté on Mixcloud](https://www.mixcloud.com/JayaPrime/adhf-houseparty-set-oldskool-breaks-n-bigbeat/) * [Stream The Dust of Gods on Mixcloud](https://www.mixcloud.com/JayaPrime/the-dust-of-gods/) Were you there on the deck of the long-lost Mojo's Coffee House when Mephie and I were closing out the final version of _Cut 'n Fisted_? Or at Namen's birthday party when I first DJd some of these from behind the counter just a week before they shut its doors forever? Maybe you made it out to Round Rock with us while HF Syphon dropped DnB beats and the entire dance floor made room for HF-1 as he pop-slapped-n-locked nearly impossibly as if floating in mid air. _Shit!_ I hope you were there, that wrecking ball of a motherfucker made stories that night! As for me, AychEff Prime, you're already here. For our lord and founder, and for the big yellow button in the sky, you can find AychEff Zero (aka, "DJ Chad Is a DJ"; aka, "Studioweary Workshop"; aka, "Chad Young") on The Secret Society of Stuff ([Spotify](https://open.spotify.com/show/2nWZxLxgASjUbhYi2K0hKP?si=d5f4436b81bc4e78)) [](https://open.spotify.com/show/2nWZxLxgASjUbhYi2K0hKP?si=d5f4436b81bc4e78). That's the most you're getting along those lines. Last anyone heard, he went to check the mail. That was a decade ago. Without the podcast, we wouldn't even have proof he was alive. Oh yeah, we also worked on _"The Shadows of Sunset"_ together ([Bandcamp](https://sanjayaprime.bandcamp.com/album/the-shadows-of-sunset)). So there's that.
